items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Georgie Boy played clarinet too, he was with that bunch.

ctx.x: Georgie Boy played clarinet too, he was with that bunch. What did you do? Well, uh, my other boy I never did mention too, he was in the band with my daddy. Had a good clarinet band, was Picoosecar Lunderville. What?
